definitions.explanation: A cat that has been abandoned by its owner, or one left to live without a home. Often used when the cat is found and taken in.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}った→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。
examples.english: I picked up an abandoned cat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}がいた。
examples.english: There was an abandoned cat in the park.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}して→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧⟦{里親|さとおや}→里親：21054_satooya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We've taken in an abandoned cat and are looking for someone to adopt it.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to throw away, abandon) + ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧ (cat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up an abandoned cat
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧: to rescue or take in an abandoned cat
- {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep an abandoned cat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{野良猫|のらねこ}→野良猫：14440_noraneko⟧: stray cat — one living wild on its own; {捨|す}て{猫|ねこ} stresses that the cat was abandoned by an owner.
